name: Haemorrhoids (piles)
description: Engorged venous cushions with inflammation/bleeding; Scorpio/8th symbolism plus Saturn (obstruction) and Mars (inflammation).
sources: Carter — Encyclopaedia of Psychological Astrology, H: Haemorrhoids.
engine_rule: If Saturn and Mars afflict Scorpio/8th or Venus, increment piles risk; reduce if benefics relieve.
